remarks:
Build your new home in a desirable rural setting just minutes from Alfred! This approximately 0.98-acre improved building lot offers a great head start with an existing driveway, well, septic system, and electric already onsite. Formerly improved with a residence, the property now offers an established homesite with much of the costly site infrastructure already in place.

Conveniently located near Alfred State College and Alfred University, with easy access to the new Saxon Hill Sports Complex and Alfred University's equestrian facilities. Outdoor recreation is also close by with both Vandermark State Forest and the 2,709-acre Phillips Creek State Forest nearby, providing access to thousands of acres of public land for hiking, hunting, horseback riding, camping, snowmobiling, and other recreational opportunities.

Kenyon Road offers an attractive country setting while remaining close to the colleges, employment, recreation, and amenities of the Alfred area. Whether you're looking to build a primary residence, college-area home, or investment property, this improved lot presents an excellent opportunity in a convenient Alfred location.

Existing well, septic, electric, and driveway are being sold AS-IS. Seller makes no representations regarding their current condition or functionality. Buyer to verify suitability of the property and existing improvements for their intended use.
